payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the BLEU score difference between the proposed insertion-deletion approach and the insertion-only method, indicating an increase of around 2 BLEU points.

claims.text: The proposed insertion-deletion approach increases the BLEU score over the insertion-only method by around 2 BLEU points.
The insertion-deletion framework significantly increases the BLEU score compared to the insertion-only framework.
The addition of deletion in the model improves the BLEU score compared to using only insertion.
